description: REQ-BILL-002 specifies link session validation using SHA-256 hash of the cookie value, but the behavioral spec does not include a pure core function for computing the hash. The effectful shell function consumeLinkSession accepts 'tokenHash' as input, implying the hash is computed elsewhere. No REQ or pure function specifies: (1) the exact hash algorithm (SHA-256), (2) encoding of the cookie value before hashing, (3) encoding of the hash output (hex vs base64). If the hash computation is treated as trivial implementation detail, it becomes a security-critical gap where different implementations could use different encodings and fail to match the auth-service's hash stored in discord_link_sessions.

evidence.snippet: WHEN POST /v1/subscriptions or POST /v1/subscriptions/cancel is received with cookie __Host-link_session THE SYSTEM SHALL validate link_session_token_hash = SHA-256(cookie)

remediation: Add a pure core function (e.g., computeLinkSessionTokenHash(cookieValue: string): string) to the purity boundary that specifies SHA-256 with a defined encoding (e.g., UTF-8 input, hex output). Add a PROP obligation verifying that this function produces the same hash format as auth-service. Alternatively, explicitly state that the shared package provides this function and billing-service imports it.
